dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses .INC copybooks with REPLACING, INDEXED files with DYNAMIC/SEQUENTIAL access, fixed format.
evidence: SELECT ... ASSIGN ... ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - monthly billing detail file creation for outpatient/self-pay receipts, point aggregation by medical category
purpose.summary: ORCR0420 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates monthly business detail files for outpatient and self-pay receipts. It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE41, RECE44, RECE45, RECE4A, RECE4B) and aggregates medical procedure points by diagnostic category. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2002-2007 covering Japanese medical fee schedule revisions.

notable_features: 35 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax (GnuCOBOL style)
Multiple INDEXED files with both DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes via separate SELECT entries for same physical file
Large program: ~7000 lines, 179 PERFORMs, extensive working-storage
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded, garbled)
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
Error file (RECEERR) for sequential error output
Extensive version history in comments (01.00.01 through 04.01.01)
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text, appearing garbled. This is the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software widely used in Japanese clinics. The // REPLACING // syntax and .INC copybook naming are characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL builds of ORCA. Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is ~350KB / 6993 lines.
